themes.title: Digital platforms, SaaS, payments & cybersecurity
themes.need: Digital-public-infrastructure scale, enterprise SaaS and a compliance/security upcycle drive a distinct platform cohort. PINELABS/NPST/CMSINFO on payments; AURIONPRO/NEWGEN/NUCLEUS/ROUTE/TANLA on banking/CPaaS software; EMUDHRA/META(544441)/AURIONPRO on digital-identity & cybersecurity; CAPILLARY/MAPMYINDIA/NAZARA on SaaS/geospatial/gaming. Q1FY27 anchored the payments leg: PAYTM's GMV grew 31% YoY (accelerating 23% -> 27% -> 31%) with merchant payments about 80% of the financial-services mix and 25-30 lakh device additions a year on a distribution-only lending model (no book, no FLDG); MOBIKWIK posted payments GMV of INR 52,400cr (+58% YoY), a 13th consecutive record quarter and India's largest wallet by GTV at ~20% share, against only ~INR 3,200cr of digital-credit GMV. OFSS adds the banking-software annuity, with RPO +17% YoY versus revenue +7% and licence-and-cloud revenue +13% at a 44% operating margin.
themes.driver: Deal/ARR additions; festive digital-payments TPV; merchant-device additions; RBI/regulatory compliance-driven security spend.

hero.oneLiner: A technology company digitizing commerce through digital payments and issuing solutions for merchants, consumer brands and enterprises, and financial institutions in India and select international markets.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: A technology company digitizing commerce through digital payments and issuing solutions for merchants, consumer brands and enterprises, and financial institutions in India and select international markets.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Pine Labs operates a Digital Infrastructure and Transaction Platform (in-store and online payment infrastructure, affordability solutions, value-added services and FinTech infrastructure) and an Issuing and Acquiring Platform (issuing, processing and distribution of prepaid instruments plus full-stack issuing/acquiring for financial institutions). It earns subscription, transaction and processing fees from merchants, consumer brands, enterprises and financial institutions. In FY2025 it processed GTV of Rs 11,424.97 billion across 5.68 billion transactions, serving 988,304 merchants, 716 consumer brands/enterprises and 177 financial institutions as of June 30, 2025.

group_structure.title: Group structure (profile)
group_structure.body:
- Pine Labs Singapore (formerly Pine Labs Pte. Ltd.) — Amalgamated entity: Dissolved without winding up pursuant to the Scheme; assets and liabilities vested in the Company
- Peak XV Partners Pine Investment Holdings — Major shareholder / nominee director appointer: Shailendra Jit Singh is its nominee on the Board
- Agya Technologies Private Limited — Group Company / Associate: NBFC-AA; currently non-compliant with RBI committee-constitution requirement (application pending)
- Synergistic — Direct subsidiary: Conduit for downstream investment into overseas step-down subsidiaries
- Qwikcilver Singapore / Pine Payment Solutions, Malaysia / Pine Labs UAE — Step-down subsidiaries: Targets of Net Proceeds international-expansion investment

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: digital infrastructure: 2% to 3% improvement in growth; flow-based revenues: growth driven by affordability and VAS

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Digital Infrastructure and Transaction Platform:** In-store and online payment infrastructure (multi-acquirer checkout, DCPs, online gateway), Affordability solutions (EMI, instant cashback, deferred payments) via Benow app, Value added services (dynamic currency conversion, payments aggregation), Business software applications marketplace (330+ apps), FinTech Infrastructure via Setu (account aggregator, UPI Switch, Bharat Connect bill payments, eKYC)
- **Issuing and Acquiring Platform:** Prepaid instrument issuing, processing and distribution (gift, loyalty, rewards, expense cards), Credit+ full-stack issuing, acquiring and transaction processing for banks and FinTechs (credit, debit, prepaid, forex cards)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Asset-light technology company operating on its own proprietary, flexible, scalable, cloud-based technology (established 2012) with an API-first, modular architecture allowing front-end and back-end to be improved independently. Capabilities have been extended across the payment value chain (in-store/online payments, affordability, VAS, transaction processing, prepaid issuing/acquiring and FinTech infrastructure) organically and through acquisitions aimed at adding specific technology and product capabilities: Qwikcilver/Pine Labs Prepaid (2019), Plural/Pine Labs Online (2021), Mosambee (2022, SMB in-store/online and affordability), QFix (2022, workflow management/SMB digitization), Setu (2022, API-based digital public infrastructure) and Credit+ (2023, full-stack issuing/acquiring/processing). It partners with acquiring banks and 40 credit partners (as of June 30, 2025); in affordability solutions the lenders bear consumer credit risk and the Company takes no consumer credit or default risk.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Revenue from operations grew 28.52% FY24 to FY25 (Rs 17,695.46m to Rs 22,742.74m)
- Contribution Margin 76.02% of revenue and Adjusted EBITDA Margin 15.68% in FY25
- Loss after tax narrowed from Rs 2,651.45m (FY23) to Rs 1,454.87m (FY25); turned to Rs 47.86m profit in Q1FY26
- Seasonality: revenue strongest in third and fourth fiscal quarters (Diwali season)
- Rising prepaid gift card float liability (Rs 36,811.54m Mar 2023 to Rs 47,736.37m Jun 2025) drives working-capital swings

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Pine Labs intends to strengthen its international presence across both operating segments in key markets such as the Middle East and Southeast Asia, deploying up to Rs 600.00 million of Net Proceeds into overseas step-down subsidiaries (Qwikcilver Singapore, Pine Payment Solutions Malaysia and Pine Labs UAE) via direct subsidiary Synergistic and Pine Labs Investments Pte. Ltd. Funds target senior talent recruitment and cloud/technology stack enhancement to scale products (Closed Loop Gift Card Program, Open Loop, Engage Hub, issuing/acquiring). It separately plans to invest up to Rs 7,600.00 million in IT assets, cloud infrastructure, DCP procurement and technology development over Fiscals 2026-2028.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: confident; focused on growth and profitability

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Ecosystem bringing together merchants, consumer brands/enterprises and financial institutions, creating network effects
- Largest player in closed and semi-closed loop gift card issuances by transaction value in India in FY2025 (Redseer)
- Largest digital affordability solution enabler at DCPs by processed value in FY2025 (Redseer)
- Full-stack, cloud-based, API-first modular technology platform (99.93%-99.99% uptime FY23-FY25)
- Deep, multi-product partnerships (10+ years) with marquee customers such as Croma and HDFC Bank
- Experienced professional management team across FinTech, payments and financial services

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: use of AI in code generation and consumer-facing touchpoints

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Repay/prepay certain identified borrowings from Net Proceeds**
- **Invest in IT assets, cloud infrastructure, DCP procurement and technology development**
- **Expenditure towards procurement of digital check-out points**
- **Invest in overseas subsidiaries Qwikcilver Singapore, Pine Payment Solutions Malaysia and Pine Labs UAE to expand presence outside India**
- **General corporate purposes and unidentified inorganic acquisitions, together not exceeding 35% of Gross Proceeds (each individually not exceeding 25%)**
- **Minimum annual cloud spend commitment to AWS for five consecutive years to 2027**
- **Raise a Fresh Issue of up to Rs 20,800.00 million**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continue integrating a broad range of constituents into the ecosystem to reinforce network effects
- International expansion in Southeast Asia and the Middle East via Qwikcilver Singapore, Pine Payment Solutions Malaysia and Pine Labs UAE
- Scale prepaid, issuing and acquiring capabilities (CLP, Open Loop, Engage Hub) in Singapore and other markets
- Grow inorganically through targeted technology and product acquisitions
- Invest in IT assets, cloud infrastructure, DCP procurement and technology development

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Guidance] Full-year FY27 revenue growth guided at 21.0%-23.5%; the deck expects higher contribution and adjusted EBITDA margins in coming quarters, and notes the business is cyclical with Q3 typically the highest-margin quarter.
- [Tax] Q1 FY27 effective tax rate was 48% because some foreign entities are not yet PAT-profitable and their losses are not available as an offset; the deck guides ETR of 28-30% for FY27 and ~25-26% from FY28, while the commentary elsewhere says it expects ETR "to taper down close to 30% for the full year FY27" (India business taxed at 25.17%).
- [Segments] Business is reported in two revenue segments — Digital Infrastructure and Transaction Platform (DITP) and Issuing and Acquiring Platform (IAP) — with IAP India up 24% YoY and IAP International up 47% YoY in Q1 FY27.
- [Deck status] The cover slide carries an internal note "To be revised for Commerce OS positioning" and is titled "Shareholders' Letter and Results Q1 FY27, 25 May 2026" while the filing letter is dated July 28, 2026 for a July 29, 2026 call.
